name: KIC 2443691
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 9.8 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2443691 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 9.751 +/- 0.1827

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2443691 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.1698 +/- 0.0491

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2443691 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4496.713 +/- 44.6983

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2443691 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.5293 +/- 0.0043

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.17 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,497 K at its surface.
